subject: Shed shelf
text: If you still plan to finish the shed shelf this weekend, it’s worth checking the level before the glue sets. When I started mine, I assumed the wall was straight, but the first panel ended up leaning a few millimeters. That made the top shelf awkward for storing the paint cans. I would loosely secure the back frame and leave the brackets off until you have all four sections placed. It’s a small thing, but it saves from having to redo the whole row later. Once that’s done, the rest should move quickly.
